The '''1947–48 Scottish Division A''' was won by [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian.]] [[Airdrieonians F.C. (1878)|Airdrieonians]] and Queen's Park finished 15th and 16th respectively and were relegated to the [[1948–49 Scottish Division B]].
